scoring_justification: Yield stress, plateau stress, and density trends are recomputed from the raw stress_strain.csv; correlation length is compared to paper reference with tolerance. This prevents a bare self-reported scalar from passing and verifies mechanical response features.

outputs.description: Equilibrated configuration in LAMMPS data format, used internally to set up the compression run.
Trajectory of the uniaxial compression, used to extract stress/strain data and compute D_min.
Stress-strain and density-strain data from uniaxial compression simulation.

schema.description: Single decimal number representing the nonaffine displacement correlation length along the chain, in number of CH2 groups.

outputs.description: Nonaffine displacement correlation length extracted from the simulation trajectory near ε = -28%.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker verifies the scored files. The intermediate outputs (sample_config.lammpsdata, compression_traj.lammpstrj) must be present but are not directly scored; they are required by the output contract.

steps.description: Validate CSV: required columns (strain, stress, density), at least 50 rows, numeric values.
Maximum stress in strain range [-15%,0%] (yield stress) compared to reference value from paper.
Average stress in strain range [-30%,-25%] (plateau flow stress) compared to reference value from paper.

checks: initial density (ε ≈ 0%) consistent with equilibrated density (~0.996 g/cm³)
density at ε ≈ -30% lower than initial density
steps.description: Density must show a physically reasonable trend: initial near equilibrated value, a peak, and final decrease.
Correlation length compared to paper reference value.
